* Greater of amount shown or earned income plus a set federal amount, but not more than the standard deduction.
† If your spouse itemizes deductions, your standard deduction is $0.
‡ If federal AGI is $125,000 or greater, the federal tax subtraction is limited. Use the federal tax subtraction worksheet.
x If federal AGI is more than $100,000 ($200,000 for a joint return), the exemption credit amount is $0.
% The additional exemption credit for a taxpayer or spouse with a severe disability or for a child with a qualifying disability is $0 if
  AGI is over $100,000, regardless of filing status.
